title: Chapter 31 Conflict
content:
Chapter 31 Conflict

Therefore, cultivating internal strength, in the first ten years, may not be as good as those who cultivate Dou Qi, but in the following time, it will slowly equalize, and reach the same power, and the victory will last for a long time, which will be in the true sense. The same level above is invincible, a person who cultivates internal strength will be able to match several, or even dozens of people who cultivate Dou Qi in the same realm.

Of course, there are not no quick exercises in cultivating inner strength. The most famous ones are in Xiaoao Jianghu, Sunflower Collection, and Star Absorbing Dafa.

As long as you pay a certain price, then the rapid increase in strength is not impossible.

There are also some inner strength and mental methods specially used in the army. As long as you continue to kill and use blood to sharpen your heart on the battlefield, your strength will increase rapidly.

Often, within a few years, you can reach the heights that can be reached in other decades or even decades. This is also the price of paying your life to gamble that you can improve quickly.

And this kind of soldiers who climbed out of the sea of blood and corpses are far stronger than ordinary people who practice ordinary internal skills.

Their instinct for killing and their deep-seated awareness of danger are as natural as they are born. These two abilities seem to be innate, allowing them to give full advantage in the battle against others, and often become the last laughing person.

And the soldiers who exchanged it by themselves are also practicing the mental methods that are dedicated to the battlefield in the army. Although it is very easy to leave hidden dangers, if you don't break through in time, your body will collapse, and you will die if you can't bear this consumption.

However, this kind of inner strength method is quick, it consumes the power of qi and blood, and absorbs the power of blood evil. In the battlefield filled with murderous aura, the cultivation speed is extremely fast. Improve your power.

Compared with this, for some people who are eager to get ahead and make achievements, the mere loss of lifespan is not worth mentioning!

More importantly, the path after cultivating internal strength is extremely broad, and there are two clear paths in front of them, guiding them in the future direction.

The first one is to continue cultivating internal strength, and slowly reach the point where in the legend of the martial arts world, the void is broken and one can see God. If nothing else, let's just say that the methods and strengths of those warriors in the world of Tang and Fengyun are so different from those of some cultivators?

The second one is to transfer to self-cultivation in the middle, to become a self-cultivator who cultivates the mind and cultivates nature and ascends to immortality. Cultivators have a lot more means than martial artists. As long as you have spiritual roots, you will practice extremely quickly.

In general, if you have enough confidence in yourself, you can practice martial arts. If you don't have enough confidence in yourself, but you happen to have spiritual roots, then you can cultivate.

A martial artist can absorb the power of heaven and earth in one body; a person who cultivates self-cultivation uses the power of heaven and earth for his own use. One is his own, and the other is borrowed from the world. The difference is quite big. The former is reserved for geniuses, and the latter is the choice of most people, depending on their aptitude.

Of course, no matter which way it is, as long as it goes to the end, it works well, and it is refined, then there is not much difference between superior and inferior.

No matter which field is the strongest, as long as you reach the final point of that path and reach the level of Dao. The strength is still similar, but at the bottom of the two fields, the strength of ordinary people is quite different.

But those at the bottom do not have as much influence on the entire field as imagined. In a world with extraordinary powers, personal power is concentrated in one. As long as the top few people are alive, then they can re-open that path again at any time. Tradition.

The difference between Eastern and Western cultivation systems flashed through his mind, Zhong Yu still prefers Eastern cultivation, because he is deeply influenced by Eastern culture, not to mention, Eastern has quick-achieving exercises, and there are also exercises that become more powerful the more you practice. Law.

What's more, in the subtleties and mysterious techniques, the eastern cultivation system must be read, it is deeper and more mysterious, and it is more powerful than the simple and crude vindictive magic of the West, without the slightest connotation. I don't know how many.

Looking at the introduction of the system, there are so many options for the cultivation of the East and the West, and the exchange of extraordinary soldiers. But there is one most crucial thing that did not appear, what is it?

Zhong Yu's face suddenly became frightened, and he asked the system in a panic: "Wait, the system? Did you forget something? Or is it that my authority has not been reached, why is there no exchange of practice exercises? Could it be that I can't Do you practice?"

Hearing Zhong Yu's question, the system seemed to be silent for a while, before replying after a long time: "The host is an emperor, wealthy, powerful, and beautiful. If you do it, you will be jealous of the heavens, and you will not die."

His face was lost for a while, and he couldn't help but have endless sadness in his heart. Could it be that I really can't cultivate? Then I imagined before, immortality, moving mountains and reclaiming seas, all kinds of incredible people, will be far away from me.

Suddenly, Zhong Yu's face brightened, as if he had grabbed a life-saving straw. It seemed that he thought of something that made him so excited.

"You mean that as an emperor, you can't cultivate and live forever? Then why did I find out that in this world? Countless countries, their kings have good cultivation, can't they cultivate? Also, I heard that in ancient China, Xuanyuan Huangdi and Chiyou, both of them had the cultivation base that penetrated the sky and the earth, and used countless immortals and gods. Don't these people practice the exercises and live forever?"

Hearing Zhong Yu's question, the system didn't seem surprised, as if it had guessed that he would ask such a question, and replied after a while.

"Those local kings have practiced exercises. However, these exercises can only increase their cultivation, not their lifespan."

"If they want to increase their lifespan, then they must give up their power and position and pass it on to their own descendants. This is the price that must be paid for gaining strength and lifespan."

"If they don't do this, let's not talk about the backlash from heaven, just talk about those gods, and the nobles in his country, and they won't want to see an immortal halo that will always be on their heads."

"So, if he doesn't want to abdicate, then someone will tell him? What will happen if he doesn't poop in that pit!"

"Let's talk about Xuanyuan and Chiyou in the East. Chiyou has a cultivation base, surpassing most immortals, but he is still greedy for wealth and power in the world, so he was defeated by Xuanyuan Huangdi, divided his corpse and used it to control the Quartet."

"After Xuanyuan Huangdi defeated Chiyou, he unified the land of China, but he reigned for only a hundred years, and then he flew away immediately to show that he did not love the riches and honors in the world. This is the agreement he reached with all the immortals and gods."

The system was a bit cold, but there were very quiet words that came over, and the trace of hope that had just risen in Zhong Yu's heart was instantly extinguished.

My heart is full of endless loss, as if what I do has no meaning, I can't enjoy all this forever, and I fight with all my life, what's the use of the whole world?

On the contrary, I still work hard, put my heart into it, and live so hard every day. I might as well just stop myself and become a rich man. Every day, I recite poems, play in the mountains and rivers, walk with beauty, and marry dozens of people at home. A beautiful wife and concubine, happy not more than a fairy.

For a while, Zhong Yu thought so ruthlessly in his heart, and he was also full of a different kind of revenge pleasure. Who was revenge on? Probably the resentment system gave him hope, but gave himself despair!

Seeing that, Zhong Yu's heart was thinking about something wrong, and the system said a word just right, which made Zhong Yu's heart re-energized, and his face was full of joy, and his fighting spirit was burning again in him.
